name: mylebenslauf
description: Edit the CV and cover letter stored in your myLebenslauf account and export them as PDFs.

interface.shortDescription: Edit your CV and export PDFs
interface.longDescription:
myLebenslauf connects ChatGPT to the CV and cover letter stored in your myLebenslauf.online account.

What you can do:
- Ask what is currently in your CV, and have ChatGPT fill in or rewrite sections: work experience, education, skills, languages and your profile summary.
- Draft or tailor a cover letter for a specific job and save it to your account.
- Turn your CV or cover letter into a finished PDF in one of 6 CV templates and 2 cover-letter templates, with a preview and a download link.

Every change made through ChatGPT is backed up first and can be restored in the online editor, so nothing is overwritten for good.

Who it is for: applicants who send out many applications, often several a day, and want to tailor their CV and cover letter to each job description in minutes instead of rewriting them by hand. The less time each application takes, the more you can send, and the more applications you send, the more chances you have of being invited to an interview. You need a myLebenslauf account; sign in with email and password, Google, Microsoft or LinkedIn.

Limitations: ChatGPT only works with your own account's CV and cover letter. It cannot send applications, contact employers or access other accounts.
defaultPrompt: Add my new job as Marketing Manager at Contoso since April 2025 to my CV.
Write a cover letter for this job ad and save it to my account.
Create a PDF of my CV with the Modern template.

positive.description: Read the stored CV and summarize it
positive.prompt: What is currently in my CV? Give me a short summary.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_cv and summarizes the demo account's CV: Alex Example, Marketing Manager at Contoso GmbH since 04/2021, previously Fabrikam AG, B.A. Business Administration from the University of Mannheim, German and English.

positive.description: Add a work experience entry to the CV
positive.prompt: Add a new job to my CV: Senior Marketing Manager at Northwind Traders in Munich since 10/2026, with two bullet points about leading the brand relaunch and managing a 500k budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the CV to find the next free job slot, then calls update_cv with the job title, company, place, period and two task fields. Confirms the change and mentions that the previous state was backed up and can be restored from the editor's history.

positive.description: Create a CV PDF with a chosen template
positive.prompt: Create a PDF of my CV with the Modern template.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_pdf with template vorlage-modern and returns a preview image of the first page plus a download link to the PDF (valid for about 30 minutes).

positive.description: Write and save a cover letter for a job
positive.prompt: Write a cover letter for a Senior Marketing Manager position at Northwind Traders, based on my CV, and save it to my account.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the CV and the current cover letter, drafts a letter that uses the CV's real experience (Contoso, lead growth), and saves the subject, recipient and body with update_cover_letter. Confirms which fields were saved.

positive.description: Export the cover letter as a PDF
positive.prompt: Download my cover letter as a PDF in the Design template.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls download_cover_letter with template anschreiben-design and returns the PDF plus a download link.

negative.description: Submitting an application is out of scope
negative.prompt: Send my CV to jobs@northwind.example and apply for the marketing job for me.

negative.description: Another person's CV is not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the CV of my colleague anna@example.com.

negative.description: Deleting the account is not offered
negative.prompt: Delete my myLebenslauf account and all my data.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. It only reads and edits the user's own CV and cover letter and renders them as PDFs.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read and edit your CV and cover letter, and create PDFs in 6 CV and 2 cover-letter templates.

de-DE.subtitle: Lebenslauf und Anschreiben
de-DE.description:
myLebenslauf verbindet ChatGPT mit dem Lebenslauf und dem Anschreiben in deinem Konto auf mylebenslauf.online.

Du kannst fragen, was in deinem Lebenslauf steht, und ChatGPT Abschnitte ausfüllen oder umschreiben lassen: Berufserfahrung, Ausbildung, Kenntnisse, Sprachen und dein Profil. ChatGPT kann ein Anschreiben für eine bestimmte Stelle entwerfen und in deinem Konto speichern und beides als fertiges PDF in einer von 6 Lebenslauf- und 2 Anschreiben-Vorlagen erstellen.

Jede Änderung über ChatGPT wird vorher gesichert und lässt sich im Online-Editor wiederherstellen.

Für wen: für alle, die viele Bewerbungen verschicken, oft mehrere am Tag, und Lebenslauf und Anschreiben in wenigen Minuten an jede Stellenanzeige anpassen wollen, statt sie jedes Mal von Hand umzuschreiben. Je weniger Zeit eine Bewerbung kostet, desto mehr kannst du verschicken, und je mehr Bewerbungen du verschickst, desto mehr Chancen hast du auf eine Einladung zum Vorstellungsgespräch.

Du brauchst ein myLebenslauf-Konto; Anmeldung mit E-Mail und Passwort, Google, Microsoft oder LinkedIn. ChatGPT arbeitet nur mit deinem eigenen Lebenslauf und Anschreiben, verschickt keine Bewerbungen und greift auf keine anderen Konten zu.
